summary: Iteration 3 comprehensive test: chat threading + context recall, task-with-due_date routing to db.tasks, notes CRUD, reminders loop presence, telegram voice handler registration, frontend chat-input blue border + thread UI + notes dialogs. Backend 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend all data-testid elements verified working end-to-end.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby - a11y warning only, not blocking

action_items: (minor) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to TaskDialog/TodoDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(minor) google_callback still has unused exception var 'e' (already flagged in iter2).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 836 lines - continues to grow; strongly consider splitting into routers (chat.py, tasks.py, todos.py, integrations.py, voice.py, reminders.py).

chat_stream builds `initial_messages` including a system role AND passes system_message separately to LlmChat - may cause duplicate system prompt injection; verify emergentintegrations handles it (works empirically, context recall test passed).
PATCH /tasks and /todos still accept arbitrary dict payload (no Pydantic patch model) - unknown keys are persisted. Recommend TaskPatch/TodoPatch with model_fields_set filter.
_reminders_loop uses UTC 'today' for user-local 'tomorrow' - acceptable for MVP but flag for TZ correctness later.
chat_stream: prior_messages legacy fallback rebuilds only first exchange - multi-turn legacy convs would lose middle turns. Acceptable since messages[] is now the canonical field.
_create_task_or_todo silently drops `due_time` for todo path (only tasks store it) - correct per rule but should be documented.
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete TEST_ tasks/todos in-flight; conversation docs left behind (expected - history preview).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 green. Verified: (a) POST /api/chat/stream with 'Ricordami di chiamare Marco domani alle 15:30, priorità alta' creates a task (not todo), due_date populated. (b) Two-turn conv with same conv_id -> LLM recalls fiscal code from prior message via initial_messages. (c) GET /api/conversations/{conv_id} returns messages: [{role,content,ts},...]. (d) Second turn on task_todo conv does NOT create duplicate task. (e) PATCH /api/tasks|/api/todos {notes} persists and returns. (f) _reminders_loop is scheduled at startup via asyncio.create_task. (g) telegram_bot.py registers MessageHandler(filters.VOICE, _msg_voice). Frontend: chat-input-card has computed borderColor rgb(110,183,236) with 2px width; history-card click opens thread-card with new-thread-btn + close-thread-btn; task-notes/task-notes-save and todo-notes/todo-notes-save round-trip works with 'Note salvate' toast.
